name: I've begun to fall in love

podcast.body: This song is presented as an example of the kind of music R. Stevie Moore was making at home, showcasing his early embrace of the low-fidelity aesthetic. The track highlights the primitive, unpolished sound quality achieved with basic home recording equipment. "Here's an example of the kind of stuff that he made at home. This is from 1976 and it's called, I've begun to fall in love."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
